result.topic_en: Treatment of the hypergeometric series in the case gamma = 1, where a logarithmic term appears, together with properties of Gauss's Pi (factorial) function: the reflection formula, the product definition and the logarithmic derivative.
result.transcription:
Hiedurch kann also die bei $x>0,5$ langsamere Convergenz auf eine schnellere gebracht werden. Diess Verfahren ist jedoch nicht anwendbar, wenn $\gamma=1$. Setzt man in diesem Fall
$Q = R - A P \log x$ wo $A = \frac{\Pi(\alpha+\beta-1)}{\Pi(\alpha-1)\Pi(\beta-1)}$
so wird
$R = A\left[2\Pi'0 - \frac{\Pi'(\alpha-1)}{\Pi(\alpha-1)} - \frac{\Pi'(\beta-1)}{\Pi(\beta-1)}\right]$
$+ (1)\alpha\beta x + [(1)+(2)]\frac{\alpha.\alpha+1.\beta.\beta+1}{1.2.1.2}xx + [(1)+(2)+(3)]\frac{\alpha.\alpha+1.\alpha+2.\beta.\beta+1.\beta+2}{1.2.3.1.2.3}x^3 + \&c$
wo
$(1) = \frac{1-(2\alpha-1)(2\beta-1)}{2\alpha\beta} = \frac{1}{\alpha}+\frac{1}{\beta}-2$
$(2) = \frac{4-2\alpha.2\beta}{4.\alpha+1.\beta+1} = \frac{1}{\alpha+1}+\frac{1}{\beta+1}-\frac{2}{2}$
$(3) = \frac{9-(2\alpha+1)(2\beta+1)}{6(\alpha+2)(\beta+2)} = \frac{1}{\alpha+2}+\frac{1}{\beta+2}-\frac{2}{3}$
&c.

$\Pi(a-1).\Pi(-a) = \frac{\pi}{\sin a\pi}$ $\Pi a.\Pi -a = \frac{a\pi}{\sin a\pi}$
$\Pi a = \frac{1.2.3.4\ldots f.f^a}{1+a.2+a.3+a\ldots f+a}$ pro $f=\infty$
[-$\log \Pi a =$-]
$\frac{\Pi' a}{\Pi a} = -\frac{1}{1+a} - \frac{1}{2+a} - \frac{1}{3+a} - \frac{1}{4+a}\ldots - \frac{1}{f+a} + \log f$
$\mathfrak{D}$[?]
$\frac{\Pi'(a-1)}{\Pi(a-1)} - \frac{\Pi'(-a)}{\Pi(-a)} = \pi\,\mathrm{cotang}\,a\pi$

methods.what: Logarithmic case gamma = 1 of the hypergeometric series: Q decomposed as R minus A P log x
Series expansion of R, with a constant term in digamma-type values and coefficients built from partial sums of (1), (2), (3), ...
Reflection formula for the Pi (Gamma) function
Gauss's product (limit) definition of the Pi function
Logarithmic derivative (digamma) of Pi as a limit of a sum
Reflection formula for the digamma function
Acceleration of slow convergence for x > 0.5 by transformation (stated in reference to the preceding page)
